prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules for specific kinds of changes, as no change type has been tested at least twice.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected results.
No kind of change has been shown to be helpful yet, as no test has yielded a statistically significant win.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -1.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: +1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -3.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Delay Sign In After Pet Selection: Move the sign-in step to occur after pet selection and photo upload so users choose their pet before creating or logging into an account. (why: Sign in conversion is 72.9% early on, causing early friction before users build attachment to their pet.)
1: [home, new_flow] Wait Time Progress and Activity Flow: Transform the waiting screen into an interactive multi-step preview flow with estimated completion time, progress status, and pet tip carousel. (why: The waiting step has an extremely high mean time of 2336s and 81.3% conversion, leaving users uncertain while assets generate.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Account Restore Clarification Notice: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in restores missing pets and syncs accounts safely. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
3: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Upload Guidance Hint: Add explicit formatting and lighting guidance hints on the upload photos screen to ensure successful custom pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results during adoption.)
4: [home, wait_info] Background Generation Notification Toggle: Add a desktop ready notification toggle and delay tip to the waiting screen so users can safely minimize the app. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336 seconds, indicating users wait extended periods without clear indication of background status.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Compact Layout Restructure: Switch choose_path to a compact layout with step counters to reduce visual clutter and decision fatigue. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users and has a long mean completion time (514s).)
6: [choose_path, incentive] Path Selection Starter Trait Banner: Add a playful mascot banner component on choose_path encouraging users to pick a path to unlock companion traits. (why: Over 23% of users abandon at the initial path selection step.)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Shortcut Tray Notification: Show a taskbar tray notification hint on home_intro when onboarding finishes. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 17.8%, and post-onboarding confusion regarding pet access is common in support logs.)

scores.note: High potential impact by delaying friction step after user engagement, but requires complete reordering.
Addresses 2336s wait time at home step with interactive preview flow, though requires new screens.
Strong alignment between sign_in drop-off and 8 support tickets; quick copy config fix.
Targets largest drop step (adoption 60.9%) supported by ticket reports of generation failure.
Addresses high wait time on home step by adding background notification toggle.
Layout redesign targeted at 23.8% initial drop, though previous redesign test showed negative lift.
Incentivizes initial path selection where 23.8% of users drop off.
Helps retention at finish step backed by post-onboarding support issues, but requires native release.
